listing.name: Player IP Flag Pack
listing.summary: Using an IP mod but don't like how it was made? Want to larp as a faction that there isn't a mod for yet? Just looking for new flags to use? Look no further! This mod will bring you everything you could possibly want from across science fiction!
listing.aiSummary: Adds a collection of science fiction flags and crests, including alternate versions.

description:
Using an IP mod but don't like how it was made? Want to larp as a faction that there isn't a mod for yet? Just looking for new flags to use? Look no further! This mod will bring you everything you could possibly want from across science fiction!

Below is a selection of flags contributed by people both in and out of the Unoffical Starsector Discord:

By Rain

By Emanator of Chair

By Bernie von Bernie; Jinkus

By iballisticperidot

Redesigns by Vexlia Artemiss

By me :3

There's alternate versions of flags if you want to use them. They're listed below

To use them, add a number to the flag name in the mod's data file.

Changelogs
v2.1:
Added credits in mod_info to flags and crests that needed them. If there's more I need to add let me know.
Changed the MCRN flag.
_________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________

v2.0:
Updated many existing flag designs.
Added new flags.
Actually fixed the Laterano bug.
Removed SOULs and EFN flags.
_________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________

v1.1:
Fixed a bug that made the Laterano flag crash the game (I hate javascript)

Download link: https://github.com/Antocerzch/Player-IP-Flag-Pack-v2.1

Make sure to download the latest version of this mod. It should be the one on top, otherwise look for the highest number.

discordPostHtml:
Flag mod that adds multiple franchise flags from things like Star Wars, Halo, The Expanse, etc.
Also includes some original designs from people.

https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=30253.msg444008#msg444008
aiDescription: Adds a large collection of flags and crests from various science fiction franchises. Includes alternate versions of flags that can be enabled by editing the mod's data file. Features contributions from multiple artists and community members.

gallery.aiCaption: A blue and white emblem featuring a stylized arrow or ship silhouette.
A blue and red octagonal emblem featuring the letters F and A.
A white stylized symbol with a letter I on a dark background.
A white geometric emblem featuring a central star and horizontal bars.
A red diamond-shaped logo with white accents on a dark background.
A white shield emblem surrounded by a laurel wreath.
A green and white crest featuring a star and wing-like shapes.
A red crossed symbol over a grey circle on a dark background.
A purple Y-shaped emblem with a horizontal bar across it.
A gold cross inside a circle surrounded by triangular shapes.
A gold sword emblem with concentric rings on a red background.
